latest_features: ShulkDub now targets Nukkit's legacy InventoryTransaction crafting path directly instead of relying on ItemStackRequest actions the server never handles

ShulkDub's non-imitate path now also uses a single legacy craft transaction so both modes stay on the same server-validated packet family
